commit.message:
DOM-79862: Clarify commit_id vs main_repo_git_ref for git-based projects (#280)

* docs(jobs): clarify commit_id vs main_repo_git_ref for GBP projects

commit_id only pins the project's internal DFS commit and cannot pin a
commit on a git-based project's main repository; main_repo_git_ref
already supports type "commitId" for that, it just wasn't documented.
No behavior change. See DOM-79862.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: mirror commit_id/main_repo_git_ref clarification into README

Same clarification as the job_start docstring update, applied to
README.md and README.adoc so Mintlify's public docs stay in sync.
DOM-79862.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: fix overgeneralized commit_id/GBP wording

commit_id doesn't unconditionally fail on git-based projects -- a
valid DFS commit SHA still works there too. It only fails when the
SHA isn't a valid DFS commit (e.g. a main-repo SHA). DOM-79862.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
